headline: Postponed painting cemetery water tanks until spring; paused several FY 2027 workplan items for the cemetery administrator.
summary: The group reviewed the FY 2027 workplan, Eldredge restoration photos for the annual report, and cemetery water, fencing, and columbarium costs. It postponed painting the water tanks until spring. A motion to wait for the cemetery administrator on certain workplan items passed unanimously.
decisions: Approved the July 14, 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.
Approved a motion to wait for the cemetery administrator before starting certain FY 2027 workplan items, unanimously.
Agreed to include before and after photos of the Eldredge restoration work in the FY 2026 Annual Report.
Continued painting of the water tanks until spring.

decision_titles: Waiting on cemetery administrator before FY 2027 work items
Eldredge restoration photos for FY 2026 Annual Report
plain_text:
Page 1 
Sextons Committee 
     DRAFT MINUTES 
September 8, 2026  
 
The Sexton’s Committee held a regular meeting on September 8, 2026 at 3:00 pm, at 180 
Market Street, 3rd Floor Conference Room 301, and by 
Zoom  https://zoom.us/j/97442869500.  
Members present: Chuck Rainville, Jennifer McClory, Peter Taylor, Richard Thorngren, 
Andrew Farrington, James Kennedy 
Also present: City Council Liaison Andrew Chalnick 
1. First item: Meeting called to order at 3:05 pm. 
 
2. Second item: No changes to the agenda 
 
3. No comments from the public. 
 
4. July 14, 2026 minutes approved unanimously. 
 
5. Review of the FY 2027 workplan resulted in agreement on items to wait for the 
cemetery administrator including items 3, 5, 6 and 7 in the Lifting of Plot Sales 
section and items 7, 8, 13, 14, and 15 in the General section.  A motion to await the 
cemetery administrator before commencing work on these passed unanimously. 
Regarding General section Item 6, Chuck will provide a photo of a Colchester 
cemetery sign for consideration.  A similar style with the cemetery rules posted 
below was suggested. For the FY 2027 work plan Andrew Chalnick suggested the 
committee identify property for the City’s open space planning that would improve 
access to the Shelburne Rd cemetery.    
 
6. The committee would like to include before and after photos of the restoration 
work done at Eldredge in the FY 2026 Annual Report.  Before pictures of Eldredge 
should be taken now before the plantings go in.  Any comments on the draft 
Annual Report are due to Chuck by Tuesday September 15th.
Sextons Committee September 08, 2026 | Page 2 
7. An updated accounting of the beautification donation spending was provided and 
reviewed with no additional comments.   
 
8. After discussion of the water tanks, it was decided that painting the tanks can wait 
until Spring and the committee will work over the winter to identify a group or 
groups interested in painting the tanks.   
 
9. The next step to seek a municipal exception in the statutes for Columbaria at 
Eldredge is to develop a draft summary of the issue and desired outcome for 
review by the committee for eventual delivery and review with State Senator 
Thomas Chittenden to determine what the next steps are.   
 
10. Details are expected from Churchill Landscaping on the watering needs of the new 
planting.  Anticipated usage is 900 gallons per week.  Three people can sign up per 
week.  Orange flags will indicate the plants for the center tank water. Watering will 
begin at the end of next week or the beginning of the week after as planting is 
completed.  The shrubs will have mounded earth and the trees will have slow 
release donuts to help with water retention and consistency.   
 
11. Peter presented the three most costly items that would improve the city 
cemeteries.  They are water service at Eldredge Cemetery, new fencing at 
Shelburne Road cemetery, and purchase of columbarium for Eldredge cemetery.  
Water service to Eldredge was previously determined to cost around $25K.  
Estimates will be needed for fencing and columbaria before bringing the request to 
Council.  Fencing would be iron to match Eldredge at the front of the Cemetery and 
sides to the swale, with chain link from the swale back.  A survey is recommended 
before fencing is replaced.   
 
12. The City Arborist is planning a volunteer tree planting day at Eldredge cemetery, 
tentatively on Saturday October 24th.  He will do advertising for the event via the 
City’s recreation emails and socials.   
 
13. Jen and Peter volunteered to add bulbs around the flag pole at Eldredge cemetery.   
 
14. In other business, Peter read a note from Nancy Simpson about John.  The 
committee is sending John a card and our best wishes.   
Following Other Business. The meeting was adjourned at 4:16 pm.
